document: New Yorkville Strategies Survey, X thread by Dimitri Pantazopoulos (Yorkville Strategies, 2026-08-11)
note: SHARES INCLUDE UNDECIDED. Online, n=1,016. Values read from the regional bar chart (tweet 2/5, all respondents); UNDECIDED = 'All Undecided'. The OneBC, CentreBC and Independent segments (each about 0-2%) are not legibly labelled on the chart and are not recorded, so rows sum to about 97-99. Decided-voter topline (tweet 1/5): NDP 46, CON 40. Regional bases not published; National n = total sample. Region labels verbatim: Metro Vancouver, Fraser Valley, Islands, Interior/North.
